title.zh: CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress
title.en: CFTC files crypto asset rulemaking with White House, pressing ahead without Congress

current_state.zh: CFTC 的加密资产市场规则制定已提交白宫 OIRA，编号 RIN 3038-AF80，处于 pre-rule（预规则）阶段，尚未成为拟议规则；提交时间为9月17日，即参议院阻止 CLARITY Act 两天后。
current_state.en: The CFTC's crypto asset market rulemaking is with White House OIRA as RIN 3038-AF80 at the prerule stage, not yet a proposed rule, filed Sept. 17, two days after the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act.
